title.zh: Rain推出嵌入式稳定币钱包，支持12条区块链并接入全球1.75亿商户

current_state.zh: Stablecoin payment platform Rain launched an embeddable multi-chain wallet that partners can integrate into their own apps, supporting 12 blockchains and USD stablecoins with spending at 175 million merchant locations via Rain-issued cards.
